claims.claim: We also deal in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim about the seller's trade, not depicted or contradicted by the photos of this single engine.

risks.risk: Exact Porsche engine model/displacement unknown, which drives value heavily
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine ID/serial plate or casting number
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unidentified Porsche engine, lowest plausible model tier

risks.risk: Unknown whether engine runs or starts
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine being started and idling

risks.risk: Unknown completeness (turbo, alternator, sensors, ECU, loom connectors)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set plus close-ups of each accessory mounting point
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete, missing ancillary components

risks.risk: Internal condition (compression, wear, prior rebuild) cannot be seen externally
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown internal condition, assume needs rebuild

risks.proof: Service sticker, ECU readout photo, or paperwork with mileage

risks.risk: Possible mismatch between badge and actual engine origin (rebadged or parts-bin unit)
risks.proof: Photo of casting/VIN number cross-checked against Porsche parts database
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified authenticity, worst-case generic engine value

proof_requests: Close-up of engine ID plate/serial/casting number
Video of engine starting and running
Full photo set of all sides including rear and underside
Any paperwork, service history, or mileage/hour indication
Photos confirming presence of turbo, alternator, ECU, and wiring loom ends
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Porsche car engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown model, unproven running state, possibly incomplete) pending further proof.
